title: Shap, UK - Moaning wind
author: Justin Bennett
notes: Window moaning in a storm, recorded from inside a house (Shap, Cumbria; Zoom H2N, FLAC 48k). Tonal, gusting moan 250-450 Hz with harmonics: the classic 'wind through the gaps'. Skipped first 20 s (one broadband gust/rattle at ~18 s). LRA ~14 dB: gusty by nature.

title: Fishermans Bothy, Isle of Mull PA69 6ER, UK - Raging storm from inside bothy on Kilfinichen Bay
author: mike
notes: Raging storm heard from inside a stone bothy on Mull (Sony M10, 48k). Broadband roar to ~3 kHz with slow gust swells, no voices. Caveats: lossy OGG source; ~90% of energy is below 60 Hz (building/mic rumble) -> high-pass ~50-60 Hz on playback. Recordist mentions dying stove embers (fits scene).

title: Troon, Camborne, Cornwall TR14, UK - Howling Wind
author: djake@live...
notes: Strong exterior howl: wind over electrical wires and through hedgerows (Cornwall; DPA4060 + Tascam DR100, FLAC). Dense steady roar below ~450 Hz with wire whistle; avoids the big gust at ~145 s. Exterior perspective - play low/filtered as 'outside'.

title: Colonel's House (fireplace), Kłodzko, Poland - 944 fireplace hiss and crackling
author: Piotrek Zyla
notes: Indoor fireplace, hiss and crackling (Colonel's House, Klodzko; Sennheiser MKH 8020 AB on Zoom F3, 96 kHz/24-bit FLAC). Very steady (envelope within ~3 dB), intimate. Caveat: only 75 s usable (file 84 s incl. fades) - shorter than the 90 s wish; pair with fire-2 for variety.

title: Colonel's House (fireplace), Kłodzko, Poland - 945 fireplace close-up (hiss)
author: Piotrek Zyla
notes: Same fireplace, close-up take (MKH 8020 AB, 96k FLAC): brighter hiss + crackle. Level drifts down ~8 dB over the segment (fire settling) - normalize/crossfade. Alternate to fire-1.

title: Troon, Camborne, Cornwall TR14, UK - Rain On The Window From Inside
author: djake@live...
notes: Rain hitting the window, recorded inside (Cornwall; DPA4060 + DR100, FLAC). Soft steady wash, low level (-46 LUFS, normalize), wide stereo. Optional pool.

title: Grandfather Clock, Hackney, London, UK - Time Passes
author: david.j.pitt
notes: Steady grandfather-clock ticking in a Victorian East End house (MixPre-3 + Beyer lavs, 320k MP3, mono content). BEAT PERIOD = 1.000 s (25 beats from 1.545 s to 26.545 s); slight tick/tock asymmetry: intervals alternate ~0.98 s / ~1.02 s. Loopable at a whole beat count (e.g. 26 beats). Clean isolated tick/tock one-shots NOT provided: single ticks are only ~7 dB above the room tone. Avoid >27.4 s (s

title: Grandfather Clock, Hackney, London, UK - Time Passes
author: david.j.pitt
notes: Same grandfather clock striking nine (9 deep bongs ~1 s apart, natural decay to ~41 s, ticking continues underneath). Caveat: 13 clipped samples on the strongest strikes (peak ~0 dBFS).

title: Grandfather Clock, Hackney, London, UK - Time Passes
